attribution.interpretation: default_BGN_on_self_consistent_state_mismatch_with_controls; state attribution is mechanism-consistent evidence, not a model-fit authorization

claim_policy.primary_comparison: Vela minus Sentaurus at n23, Vd=0.05 V, Vg=0.05 V
claim_policy.adjacent_gate_test: compare the target discrepancy with the exact Vg=0.00 V and 0.10 V states in each solver
claim_policy.nwell_control_test: compare n23 against matched n19 at every gate point and difference the cross-solver discrepancies
claim_policy.target_localization: a metric may be called target-localized only when the n23 Vg=0.05 discrepancy is an interior extremum relative to both adjacent gates and exceeds the matched n19 discrepancy in the same direction
claim_policy.causal_claim_guard: state correlation alone is descriptive; the report must separate observed state mismatch, current-consistent mechanism, and unresolved residual
claim_policy.outcome_policy: a null or mixed attribution is a valid completed result

forbidden_work_respected: global HFS parameter scans or default tuning
BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, solver, or production-default changes
rewriting M8, M45, or M46 artifacts
